license_required.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the Arizona medical board

name.quote: Board means the Arizona medical board

type.quote: Board means the Arizona medical board

moral_character_required.quote: Have a professional record that indicates that the applicant has not committed any act or engaged in any conduct that would constitute grounds for disciplinary action against a licensee under this chapter

degree_required.quote: Graduate from an approved school of medicine or receive a medical education that the board deems to be of equivalent quality

accrediting_body.value: Association of American Medical Colleges, Association of Canadian Medical Colleges, or American Medical Association
accrediting_body.quote: whose course of study has been approved or accredited by an educational or professional association, recognized by the board, including the association of American medical colleges, the association of Canadian medical colleges or the American medical association

required.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program

duration.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program

kind.value: hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program
kind.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.quote: has passed steps one and two of the United States medical licensing examination or one of the examination combinations prescribed in section 32-1426, subsection A, paragraph 6

exams.name: USMLE Step 3
exams.quote: successful passage of step three of the United States medical licensing examination with a scaled score of at least seventy-five if the applicant has passed all three steps within a seven year period

exams.name: Special Purpose Licensing Examination
exams.quote: The board may require an applicant seeking licensure by endorsement based on successful passage of a written examination or combination of examinations, the most recent of which precedes by more than ten years the application for licensure by endorsement in this state, to take and pass a special purpose licensing examination

interval_years.quote: each person holding an active license to practice medicine in this state shall renew the license every other year on or before the licensee's birthday

required.quote: A person who holds an active license to practice medicine in this state shall satisfy a continuing medical education requirement that is designed to provide the necessary understanding of current developments, skills, procedures or treatment related to the practice of medicine in such amount and during such period as the board establishes by rule

available.quote: An applicant who is licensed in another jurisdiction or whose license under this chapter has been revoked or surrendered or has expired and who meets the applicable requirements prescribed in section 32-1422, 32-1423 or 32-1424, has paid the fees required by this chapter and has filed a completed application found by the board to be true and correct is eligible to be licensed to engage in the practice of medicine in this state through endorsement

requirements.value: Applicant must be certified by the national board of medical examiners or have successfully passed equivalent examination, or meet other specified examination combinations
requirements.quote: The applicant is certified by the national board of medical examiners or its successor entity as having successfully passed all three parts of the United States medical licensing examination or its successor examination

exists.quote: Board means the Arizona medical board

national_association.value: American Medical Association, Association of American Medical Colleges
national_association.quote: whose course of study has been approved or accredited by an educational or professional association, recognized by the board, including the association of American medical colleges, the association of Canadian medical colleges or the American medical association

regulatory_model.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter

credential_type.quote: Active license means a valid and existing license to practice medicine

is_mandatory.quote: A person who practices medicine in this state after that person's active license has expired is in violation of this chapter

title_protection.quote: The use of the designation M.D. in a way that would lead the public to believe that a person was licensed to practice medicine in this state

scope_protection.quote: The practice of medicine by a person not licensed or exempt from licensure pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any federal or state laws, rules or regulations applicable to the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any federal or state laws, rules or regulations applicable to the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally disclosing a professional secret or privileged communication except as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally disclosing a professional secret or intentionally disclosing a privileged communication except as either act may otherwise be required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing false, fraudulent, deceptive or misleading advertising by a doctor of medicine or the doctor of medicine's staff, employer or representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a felony, whether or not involving moral turpitude, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate records on a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate records on a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exhibiting a pattern of using or being under the influence of alcohol or drugs while practicing medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibiting a pattern of using or being under the influence of alcohol or drugs or a similar substance while practicing medicine or to the extent that judgment may be impaired and the practice of medicine detrimentally affected

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using controlled substances except if prescribed by another physician for use during a prescribed course of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using controlled substances except if prescribed by another physician for use during a prescribed course of treatment

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances to members of the physician's immediate family
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances to members of the physician's immediate family

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or administering schedule II controlled substances in violation of regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering schedule II controlled substances as prescribed by section 36-2513 or the rules adopted pursuant to section 36-2513, including amphetamines and similar schedule II sympathomimetic drugs in the treatment of exogenous obesity for a period in excess of thirty days in any one year

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or administering any controlled substance or prescription-only drug for other than accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering any controlled substance or prescription-only drug for other than accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except as provided in sections 32-1491 and 32-3248.03
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except as provided in sections 32-1491 and 32-3248.03

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank, undated or predated prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a blank, undated or predated prescription form

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross malpractice, repeated malpractice or any malpractice resulting in the death of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing conduct that the board determines is gross malpractice, repeated malpractice or any malpractice resulting in the death of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that a manifestly incurable disease can be permanently cured or that any disease can be cured by a secret method
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing that a manifestly incurable disease or infirmity can be permanently cured, or that any disease, ailment or infirmity can be cured by a secret method, procedure, treatment, medicine or device, if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to divulge to the board the means, method, procedure, modality of treatment or medicine used
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to divulge to the board on demand the means, method, procedure, modality of treatment or medicine used in the treatment of a disease, injury, ailment or infirmity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having action taken against the physician by another licensing jurisdiction for medical incompetence or unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having action taken against a doctor of medicine by another licensing or regulatory jurisdiction due to that doctor of medicine's mental or physical inability to engage safely in the practice of medicine or the doctor of medicine's medical incompetence or for unprofessional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having sanctions imposed by an agency of the federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having sanctions imposed by an agency of the federal government, including restricting, suspending, limiting or removing a person from the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of the patient or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any conduct or practice that is or might be harmful or dangerous to the health of the patient or the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a formal order, probation, consent agreement or stipulation issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a formal order, probation, consent agreement or stipulation issued or entered into by the board or its executive director under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making any false or fraudulent statement in connection with the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any false or fraudulent statement, written or oral, in connection with the practice of medicine or if applying for privileges or renewing an application for privileges at a health care institution

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging a fee for services not rendered or dividing professional fees for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging a fee for services not rendered or dividing a professional fee for patient referrals among health care providers or health care institutions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a fee by fraud, deceit or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging or collecting a clearly excessive fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging or collecting a clearly excessive fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using experimental forms of diagnosis and treatment without adequate informed patient consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using experimental forms of diagnosis and treatment without adequate informed patient consent, and without conforming to generally accepted experimental criteria

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual conduct with a current patient or with a former patient within six months after the last medical consultation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual conduct with a current patient or with a former patient within six months after the last medical consultation unless the patient was the licensee's spouse at the time of the contact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice medicine by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice medicine or a license renewal by fraud, by misrepresentation or by knowingly taking advantage of the mistake of another person or an agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or claiming to be a medical specialist if this is not true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or claiming to be a medical specialist if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a professional connection with or lending one's name to enhance the activities of an illegal practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Maintaining a professional connection with or lending one's name to enhance or continue the activities of an illegal practitioner of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish information in a timely manner to the board or its investigators
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish information in a timely manner to the board or the board's investigators or representatives if legally requested by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to allow properly authorized board personnel to examine and access documents and records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to allow properly authorized board personnel on demand to examine and have access to documents, reports and records maintained by the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly failing to disclose to a patient a direct financial interest in a separate diagnostic or treatment agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly failing to disclose to a patient on a form that is prescribed by the board and that is dated and signed by the patient or guardian acknowledging that the patient or guardian has read and understands that the doctor has a direct financial interest in a separate diagnostic or treatment agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using chelation therapy in the treatment of arteriosclerosis without adequate informed consent and approval
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using chelation therapy in the treatment of arteriosclerosis or as any other form of therapy, with the exception of treatment of heavy metal poisoning, without adequate informed patient consent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or administering anabolic-androgenic steroids for other than therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or administering anabolic-androgenic steroids to a person for other than therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exhibiting a lack of or inappropriate direction, collaboration or direct supervision of a medical assistant or health care provider
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exhibiting a lack of or inappropriate direction, collaboration or direct supervision of a medical assistant or a licensed, certified or registered health care provider employed by, supervised by or assigned to the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false or misleading statement to the board or on a form required by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making a false or misleading statement to the board or on a form required by the board or in a written correspondence, including attachments, with the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to dispense drugs and devices in compliance with article 6 of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to dispense drugs and devices in compliance with article 6 of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence or negligence resulting in harm to or the death of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing conduct that the board determines is gross negligence, repeated negligence or negligence resulting in harm to or the death of a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a representation that the doctor is boarded or board certified if this is not true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a representation by a doctor of medicine or the doctor of medicine's staff, employer or representative that the doctor of medicine is boarded or board certified if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to a body fluid examination or any other examination to detect alcohol or other drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to a body fluid examination or any other examination known to detect the presence of alcohol or other drugs as required by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report in writing to the board any evidence that a doctor of medicine is medically incompetent or guilty of unprofessional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report in writing to the Arizona medical board or the Arizona regulatory board of physician assistants any evidence that a doctor of medicine or a physician assistant is or may be medically incompetent, guilty of unprofessional conduct or mentally or physically unable to safely practice medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: As a physician who is the chief executive officer, medical director or medical chief of staff of a health care institution, failing to report that hospital privileges have been denied, revoked, suspended, supervised or limited
disciplinary_grounds.quote: As a physician who is the chief executive officer, the medical director or the medical chief of staff of a health care institution, failing to report in writing to the board that the hospital privileges of a doctor of medicine have been denied, revoked, suspended, supervised or limited

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming to be a current member of the board or its staff or a board medical consultant if this is not true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claiming to be a current member of the board or its staff or a board medical consultant if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to make patient medical records promptly available to other licensed practitioners upon proper authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to make patient medical records in the physician's possession promptly available to a physician assistant, a nurse practitioner, a person licensed pursuant to this chapter or a podiatrist, chiropractor, naturopathic physician, osteopathic physician or homeopathic physician licensed under chapter 7, 8, 14, 17 or 29 of this title on receipt of proper authorization

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or furnishing a prescription medication unless the licensee first conducts a physical or mental health status examination or has previously established a doctor-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or furnishing a prescription medication or a prescription-only device as defined in section 32-1901 to a person unless the licensee first conducts a physical or mental health status examination of that person or has previously established a doctor-patient relationship

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing office-based surgery using sedation in violation of board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing office-based surgery using sedation in violation of board rules

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name in this state

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, the treatment or the correction of or the attempt or the claim to be able to diagnose, treat or correct any and all human diseases, injuries, ailments, infirmities or deformities, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means, methods, devices or instrumentalities
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, the treatment or the correction of or the attempt or the claim to be able to diagnose, treat or correct any and all human diseases, injuries, ailments, infirmities or deformities, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means, methods, devices or instrumentalities

methods_authorized.quote: Includes the practice of medicine alone or the practice of surgery alone, or both

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe and dispense drugs and devices subject to board regulations and restrictions on controlled substances
drug_authority.quote: a doctor of medicine may dispense drugs and devices kept by the doctor if

license_status_types.quote: Active license means a valid and existing license to practice medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must hold a standard certificate from the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates, complete a fifth pathway program, or serve as a full-time assistant professor or higher at an approved school of medicine for 36 months
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Hold a standard certificate issued by the educational commission for foreign medical graduates, complete a fifth pathway program as provided in section 32-1424, subsection A, or complete thirty-six months as a full-time assistant professor or in a higher position in an approved school of medicine

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Successfully complete an approved twelve-month hospital internship, residency or clinical fellowship program

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Schedule II opioids may not be dispensed by physicians except for implantable devices or opioids for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A doctor of medicine may not dispense a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid, except for an implantable device or an opioid that is for medication-assisted treatment for substance use disorders

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may conduct physical or mental health status examinations through telehealth with appropriate clinical evaluation, except for certain exemptions including emergency situations and public health programs
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The physical or mental health status examination may be conducted through telehealth as defined in section 36-3601 with a clinical evaluation that is appropriate for the patient and the condition with which the patient presents

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: Beginning September 1, 2017, applicants for expedited licensure pursuant to section 32-3241 shall submit a full set of fingerprints to the board for the purpose of obtaining a state and federal criminal records check

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A person renewing an active license to practice medicine in this state shall provide to the board as part of the renewal process a report of disciplinary actions, restrictions or any other action placed on or against that person's license or practice by another state licensing or disciplinary board or an agency of the federal government

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: The chief executive officer, the medical director or the medical chief of staff of a health care institution shall inform the board if the privileges of a doctor to practice in that health care institution are denied, revoked, suspended or limited because of actions by the doctor

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish a confidential program for the treatment and rehabilitation of doctors of medicine who are licensed pursuant to this chapter and physician assistants who are licensed pursuant to chapter 25 of this title and who are impaired by alcohol or drug abuse

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board or, if delegated by the board, the executive director shall require, at the doctor's expense, any combination of mental, physical or oral or written medical competency examinations

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may issue a registration to allow a doctor of medicine who is not a licensee to provide locum tenens medical services to substitute for or temporarily assist a doctor of medicine who holds an active license
